facts.fact: The EACO statistics report names Uganda, through its regulator UCC, as one of seven member states submitting communications sector data to the East African Communications Organisation.

EACO reports Uganda's One Network Area inbound cross-border voice traffic fell 28.0% in 2025, from 1,103.2 million to 794.4 million minutes, which it attributes to over-the-top services substituting voice.
